plan.goal: Replace the low-fi 3-trait placeholder game system with the full genliv rules: 7 caractéristiques (FO/AG/DX/EN/IN/IG/CA), 4 Tiers de Challenge (TC1–TC4), a 23-monster canonical bestiary, WEAPONS/PROTECTIONS registries, and pure play-mode functions (combat, XP) — all as data-driven KR-117 registries so the editor picks options from them and play mode resolves them.
acceptance_criteria: CHARACTERISTICS registry has exactly 7 entries (FO/AG/DX/EN/IN/IG/CA) with label, abbr, and describe fields; CHARACTERISTIC_MAX = 12
CHALLENGE_TIERS registry has 4 entries (TC1–TC4) with label, difficulty, dice, notation, baseXp; DEFAULT_CHALLENGE_TIER = TC1
WEAPONS registry has 8 entries; PROTECTIONS registry has 4 entries; each with label and combat multiplier/reduction field
BESTIARY has 23 monsters (BestiaryRow[] mapped via toConfig()) seeded idempotently into MonsterLibrary on first launch via seedDefaults(BESTIARY)
seedDefaults() is deletion-safe: a user who removes bestiary entries is never re-seeded on the next launch (MONSTER_LIBRARY_SEEDED_KEY guard)
TrapEditor renders SegmentedControl (abbr labels) for trait and SegmentedControl (TC1·1D6…TC4·4D4) for tier; deprecated difficulty dropped on write
ObjectEditModal renders same SegmentedControls for trait and tier in the « jet requis » section; deprecated difficulty dropped on write

MonsterEditor renders a full stat block UI: 5 Steppers for MONSTER_CHARACTERISTICS (FO/AG/DX/EN/IG), MC, PV, PV Variance, Armure steppers, natural-weapon multiplier <select>, Tier SegmentedControl (T1–T4), and Capacité Field
ObjectEditor renders an « Effet d'équipement » section: SegmentedControl (Aucun/Arme/Protection) + conditional <select> from WEAPONS or PROTECTIONS
gameSystem.test.ts: §1 characteristics, §2 challenge resolution, §3 combat (maitriseDesCoups/ecartBand/pfBase/resolveAssault), §4 bestiary, §5 XP — all via injectable-RNG pure functions
BrainContext.createBrain() calls monsterLibrary.seedDefaults(BESTIARY) after creating the service
brain/index.ts exports all new registries and pure helpers
plan.walking_skeleton: Replace CHARACTERISTICS from 3-trait placeholder to 7-carac registry; add CHALLENGE_TIERS replacing numeric difficulty; add WEAPONS/PROTECTIONS; add BESTIARY + seedDefaults; update editor UIs (TrapEditor, ObjectEditModal, MonsterEditor, ObjectEditor) to pick from the new registries.

iterations.goal: Full game system pack: 7 caracs, TC1–TC4, WEAPONS/PROTECTIONS, bestiary, editor UI updates, pure play helpers

known_risks: KR-130: REGLES-DU-JEU.md is the single source of truth — two coherence corrections baked in (EN malus order; harmonised challenge dice).
KR-131: Authoring vs play split — editor stores schema (which tier, which monster block); PV/PE/combat/XP are pure helpers deferred to play mode.

KR-132: seedDefaults() is deletion-safe — the seeded flag prevents re-injection after the user deletes entries; tests must suppress with localStorage.setItem('genliv:monster-library:seeded', 'true') in beforeEach.

KR-021: Schema migration — persisted SkillRoll.difficulty is migrated via rollTier() on read and dropped on write; persisted MonsterConfig.attack/defense are kept as @deprecated optional fields and ignored on write.
KR-101: BESTIARY monsters are COPY-ON-USE templates — instantiating one creates an independent copy; the library entry is never shared.

iterations_log.label: iteration-1 (full game system pack)
architecture_choices: All registries follow KR-117: a single Record<Union, Descriptor>; editors derive options/labels from the registry, never a hardcoded list, never an if/switch on the union.

AUTHORING vs PLAY split (KR-131): editor components import only type/registry parts (CHARACTERISTICS, CHALLENGE_TIERS, WEAPONS); pure play helpers (resolveChallenge, resolveAssault, combatXp) live in brain/ as injectable-RNG functions.
SegmentedControl uses `T extends string`, so MonsterTier (1|2|3|4 number) is bridged via MonsterTierKey ('T1'|'T2'|'T3'|'T4') in MonsterEditor.

RevealEditor (Écouter/Fouiller) is NOT migrated to tier in this pack — it still uses the legacy Stepper for difficulty. A `?? DEFAULT_DIFFICULTY` fallback was added to satisfy the new `difficulty?: number` union type. This is deferred to a future iteration.
seedDefaults guards on MONSTER_LIBRARY_SEEDED_KEY (one-time, deletion-safe, KR-132). The flag is set BEFORE the commit() call so a crash between the two does not re-seed on restart.
BestiaryRow[] is an intermediate typed shape; toConfig() maps it to MonsterConfig with templateId derived from the name slug, making BESTIARY_BY_TEMPLATE a stable lookup by slug.
deviations_from_plan: RevealEditor (action-decor Écouter/Fouiller) not migrated to tier SegmentedControl — it still uses the legacy Stepper; the test assertion for the Écouter roll was updated from `trait: 'endurance'` to `trait: 'EN'` (key change only).
